Key terms: - Food preservation = உணவு பாதுகாப்பு | Ways to make food last longer. - Spoilage = கெட்டுப்போவது | When food becomes bad or unsafe. - Drying = உலர்த்துதல் | Removing water from food. - Boiling = கொதிக்கவைத்தல் | Heating food or liquid strongly. - Cooling = குளிர்வித்தல் | Keeping food cool. - Freezing = உறையவைத்தல் | Keeping food very cold until it freezes. - Salting = உப்பு சேர்த்தல் | Using salt to preserve food. - Pickling = ஊறுகாய் செய்தல் | Preserving food using vinegar, salt, or sugar. - Smoking = புகையூட்டுதல் | Using smoke to preserve food. - Pasteurisation = பாஸ்சுரைசேஷன் | Heating liquid food to reduce harmful microorganisms. chunks.text: Topic: Food Preservation Source: SAINS T6 SJKT.pdf Generated by AI-EZAM source converter. NEEDS_REVIEW: Review misconception guidance against source diagrams and examples. Common misconceptions and correction guidance: - Wrong idea: food preservation makes food last forever. Correction: it helps food last longer, but not forever. - Wrong idea: only refrigerators preserve food. Correction: many methods can preserve food. - Wrong idea: all microorganisms in food are useful. Correction: some can spoil food and make us sick. - Wrong idea: spoiled food is always safe if it looks normal. Correction: spoiled or contaminated food can be unsafe.
